events.summary: Optimizing OnPrem Deployments: A Deep Dive into BMC Helix’s Latest Releases
events.description:
Join us for an in-depth webinar showcasing the latest innovations introduced in BMC Helix OnPrem with releases 25.3 and 25.4. This session is designed for architects, administrators, and technical stakeholders looking to understand how the newest capabilities can streamline deployment, enhance security, and reduce operational overhead across their Helix environments.

We will walk through a comprehensive overview of new features and enhancements, including:

 

  • New technology support that expands compatibility and ensures your OnPrem ecosystem remains aligned with modern infrastructure standards.
  • Minimized footprint deployment options, such as the ITSM Core Flavor and the associated design partnership program, as well as targeted PCS deployments focused on delivering only the services you need.
  • New functionality and product support for OnPrem environments, including BHAC, HelixGPT, and updated deployment flows for both Core and Full ITSM flavors. We will also cover the new autofix flow, improvements to the Health Check Tool (HCT) and DTR cleanup script. 
  • New sizing options, featuring expanded documentation and the introduction of the ITOM XS sizing category to better support smaller-scale deployments.
  • Enhanced security features, including mTLS, certificate-based authentication, improved certificate handling, and support for multiple identity providers.

 Whether you are planning an upgrade or looking to optimize your existing environment, this webinar will offer valuable insights to help you get the most out of the latest BMC Helix OnPrem deployment capabilities. We look forward to your participation.
